'''Rill scales''' were scales taken from [[Rill (species)|rills]], lizard-like creatures native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], rill scales became a hot fashion item in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], and nobles and merchants paid large sums to acquire scales.
